He is best known for his work 'Thirumurugatruppadai' which is a commentary on the Tamil version of the 'Murugasubramaniya Upanishad'. This work is considered an important contribution to the Tamil literary tradition and is still widely studied and recited in South India.

Muthukumar was also a great saint and a prominent figure in the Shaivite tradition of Hinduism. He is believed to have lived in the 10th century and is known for his devotion to Lord Shiva. He composed several hymns in praise of Shiva and is regarded as an important spiritual figure in the Shaivite tradition.
